acceptance: Explicit preview button compares recomputed current and unsaved draft scoring on at most 100 current-profile/current-version stored matches; reports sample ranks, score delta, contributions and provenance.

Uses one database read snapshot, saved-search semantic and source filters, stable ties, bounded dimensions and explicit truncation. Does not audit, save, rescore persisted matches, submit or call providers.
Scope mismatches are 404; stale expected versions are 409; invalid, empty or over-32-dimension drafts are 422. Advanced workspace job_filters are explicitly rejected rather than silently ignored.

Connected Chromium preview produces aligned current=75, draft=100, delta=25; every table is unchanged. Editing hides results immediately; a held stale response after editing never restores them; changing scope also hides them.

Client verifies scope/version, count caps, unique jobs/dimensions, rank ordering, score deltas and weighted contributions against the actual requested draft. UNKNOWN null provenance and legacy all-unknown fallback remain explicit.
Editor shows the effective default Skills weight of 100 for old sparse and new drafts; explicit zero remains zero. No hidden baseline score weighting.

checks.note: TypeScript and Vite build; existing chunk-size warning remains. Node 25.9.0, Python 3.12.10.

red_first.note: Preview endpoint absent before implementation; all acceptance cases failed first.

limitations: Sample is not the live application queue: it can contain hidden/blacklisted historical matches; the UI states this. Workspace-only advanced job_filters currently fail closed.
100-row cap can omit other relevant jobs; ranks are explicitly local to the inspected sample, never global claims.
Store scores are not updated until normal explicit save/recalculation. Current scores in preview are recomputed, not durable score readback.
PostgreSQL path implemented but NOT_RUN. Full repository Python suite, external ATS and independently delegated review NOT_RUN.
Main integration BLOCKED_BY_ACTIVE_INTEGRATOR; canonical tracker unchanged, TRACKER_REFRESH_PENDING. Whole MJ-REQ-117 remains PARTIAL.
Hosted CI/review, new paid services and real employer submissions OFF.
